note: Re-judged 2026-10-27 by an independent judge (authored none of the change) after phase 1 of spec-add-path-limit-send-receive respelled the config. Section 3: "A BGP speaker that wishes to indicate support for multiple AFI/SAFIs MUST do so by including the information in a single instance of the PATHS-LIMIT capability." TestBuildOpenCoalescesPathsLimit is unchanged and remains the proof: it drives buildOpen with several PATHS-LIMIT inputs (an empty configured instance, a configured ipv4/unicast tuple, two raw code-76 plugin payloads with a duplicate and a zero tuple), re-parses the encoded OPEN, and asserts require.Len(limits, 1) (negative) and the exact two-entry content [ipv4/unicast 4, ipv4/multicast 3] (positive); coalescePathsLimit in session_negotiate.go is the enforcing function. The only change to TestParsePeerCapabilityPathsLimitSingleInstance is the per-family limit spelling: "limit": "10"/"20" became receiveLimit("10")/("20"), i.e. {"receive": "N"}, which addPathReceiveLimit parses to the same uint16 the deleted parseUint16 returned; its assertion of one *capability.PathsLimit holding both families is byte-identical and passes. It stays a subordinate config-path guard one hop short of the wire, as previously judged. Enforced stands.
